description: This Java class defines a Spring Boot REST controller named OwnerController, which manages in-memory owner data for a pet clinic application. It provides endpoints to list all owners and to retrieve owner details by ID. Additionally, it uses Swagger/OpenAPI annotations for API documentation.

classes.name: OwnerController
classes.description: A REST controller for managing owner data in the Petclinic demo application.

methods.name: listOwners
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list all owner records, returning a list of owner data.

methods.name: getOwner
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve owner details by their ID; returns 404 if not found.
